info.name: School Management System API
info.description: Complete API collection for the School Management System including authentication, user management, class management, staff management, subject management, role & permission management, and timetable management.

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Register a new user with a specific role. Valid roles: super-admin, principal, vice-principal, head-of-department, teacher, accountant, admin-staff, student
Login with email and password to get access token
Logout and revoke all access tokens

item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, and logout

request.description: Get all users with pagination, search, filtering, and sorting. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Create a new user with a specific role. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get a specific user by ID with roles and permissions. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Update an existing user. All fields are optional. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Delete a user by ID. Cannot delete super-admin users or your own account. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get roles and permissions for a specific user. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Assign a role to a specific user. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Delete multiple users at once. Cannot delete super-admin users or your own account. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get all available roles for assignment. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get current authenticated user's profile with roles and permissions.
Update current authenticated user's profile. Password change requires current password verification.

query.description: Search by name, code, or description

request.description: Get all subjects with pagination, search, filtering, and sorting. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Create a new subject. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get a specific subject by ID with staff and classes relationships. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Update an existing subject. All fields are optional. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Delete a subject by ID. Cannot delete if subject is used in timetables. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Delete multiple subjects at once. Cannot delete subjects used in timetables. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get all classes with pagination. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Create a new class. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get a specific class by ID with teacher and timetable information. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Update an existing class. All fields are optional. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Delete a class by ID. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Assign a teacher to a specific class. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Assign subjects to a specific class. This will replace existing assignments. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get all subjects assigned to a specific class. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get the complete timetable for a specific class. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Create or update the complete timetable for a class. This will replace all existing timetable entries. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get all staff members with pagination. Requires super-admin or principal role.

request.description: Create a new staff member. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get a specific staff member by ID. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Update an existing staff member. All fields are optional. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Delete a staff member by ID. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Assign sections to a staff member. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Assign subjects to a staff member. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Assign a role to a staff member. Requires super-admin or principal role.
Get all subjects assigned to a specific staff member. Requires super-admin or principal role.

item.name: Academic Calendar

request.description: Retrieve all academic calendar events, ordered by event date
Retrieve calendar events for a specific academic session
Create a new academic calendar event
Retrieve a specific calendar event with its session information
Update an existing calendar event
Delete a calendar event

item.description: Academic calendar management endpoints for managing school events and important dates

item.name: Academic Sessions

request.description: Retrieve all academic sessions with pagination and calendar count
Create a new academic session. If current is set to true, all other sessions will be marked as not current.
Retrieve a specific academic session with its calendar events
Update an academic session. If current is set to true, all other sessions will be marked as not current.
Delete an academic session. This will also delete all associated calendar events.

item.description: Academic session management endpoints for CRUD operations

item.name: Parent Management

request.description: Retrieve all parents with pagination
Create a new parent with user account
Retrieve a specific parent by ID
Update parent information
Delete a parent (this will also delete the associated user account)

item.description: Complete CRUD operations for parent management

request.description: Retrieve all students
Create a new student with parent assignment
Create a new student with parent assignment
Create a new student with parent assignment
Retrieve a specific student by ID
Assign a parent to a student
Delete a student

item.description: Student management with parent relationship functionality
